1rqwctz.description_en:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION], we can really make it worth your while.
-Bit Zeros

问题是——这个人雇来策划这场事故的家伙们，现在觉得这事儿能赚更多，干脆赖在那艘死人飞船旁边不走了，不肯撒手。

这帮人可不讲武德，你最好带俩帮手，不然分分钟凉透。但只要你能把黑匣子搞出来，送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，咱保证让你赚得盆满钵满。

- 零比特

Hockrow Agency
Case File #BR83215
Lead Investigator: Arken Mallor
Case Summary:
Client hired the agency to look into the destruction of one of their ships near [LOCATION]. They are claiming that the ship was destroyed by an ex-partner and need the blackbox to prove it.

Dispatch to [LOCATION] and locate the derelict ship. Secure the area from any hostiles. Retrieve the blackbox and deliver it to [DESTINATION].

xyoqyf.description_en:
Call me Twitch. I run the Dead Saints.
I doubt this is the first time you've heard of us, but in case you haven't, we do a lot of things, but one of them is transporting goods that need discreet handling.
I got your info from one of my contacts. They say you've got the stuff we like in a hauler, which works for me, because we're looking for one.
Here's my proposal – we're offering creds to the pilot that can transport some special cargo for us. Your ship’s hold will need room for 2 SCU cargo containers, and you'll need a handheld tractor beam for loading and unloading. All you have to do is get everything from [LOCATION] to [DESTINATION] without getting security involved.
If you can pull the job off, the Saints will have more contracts for you down the line.
-Twitch
xyoqyf.description_zh:
叫我刺痛。死亡圣徒由我管着。

你八成听过我们名号，没听过也无所谓——我们啥都干，但最拿手的就是运些得偷偷摸摸处理的货。

我是从我的一个线人那儿打听到你的，他说你驾驶的运输船有东西挺符合咱们的胃口。

我的方案是这样的——我们出信用点，找人运一票特殊货。你船舱得能塞下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱</EM4>，还得配个手持式牵引光束，好装货卸货。你唯一要做的，就是从 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 把东西运到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，别惊动安保。

事儿办漂亮了，以后死亡圣徒的活儿，少不了你。
- 刺痛

l0604z.description_en:
Greetings,
Crusader Security Forces have contacted us seeking our expertise in dealing with an urgent situation. Several platforms near Orison have been overtaken by members of the Nine Tails gang and Northrock is eager to staff an operation to remove them and return the platforms to Crusader.
The Nine Tails have put measures in place to block all air traffic in the area, so we've been granted access to a secure shuttle that will take you, and any other members of your assault team, to the first platform.
For full disclosure, I must warn that this is not a contract for the faint of heart. I am confident though that your combat skills, you and your selected team will be fully up to the challenge.
Once you've arrived at the shuttle I'll be in touch directly with more information.
Speak more soon,
Adrienne Du-Buisson
Logistics Officer - Stanton Branch
Northrock Service Group

九尾已采取措施封锁了该区域的所有空中交通，所以我们获准提供一艘安保穿梭机，将你和你的突击队的其他成员运送至第一个平台。

为了充分披露，我必须提醒：这不是一份适合胆小鬼的任务。但我相信你的战斗技巧，凭借你和你所选团队，你们完全能够应对这一挑战。

等你登上穿梭机，我会直接与你联系并提供更多信息。

稍后详谈，
艾德里安·杜-布伊松
后勤官员 - 斯坦顿分部
北境之岩服务团队

narzm0.description_en:
A Citizens for Prosperity ship has been ambushed by a group of outlaws over at [LOCATION] and we need a skilled pilot to help them out.
We lost contact with them mid comms, but it sounded like they were taking heavy fire. It may be too late for them, but the vital supplies they were carrying could still be put to good use. Fly over there, take out any hostiles, and recover the shipment. You'll need a ship that can support [MAX_SCU] cargo containers and a heavy-duty tractor beam to transport the supplies onto your ship.
Take them to the freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll guarantee they'll be put to good use.
Be safe out there,
Lima Endicott
Lead Dispatcher
Citizens for Prosperity
narzm0.description_zh:
一艘繁荣公民的飞船在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 遭到一伙不法分子伏击，急需一名技术娴熟的飞行员前去支援。

我们中途与他们失联了，但最后听到的通讯里，他们似乎正承受猛烈火力。他们或许已凶多吉少，但他们所运送的关键物资仍有可能派上用场。请立即飞赴现场，清除所有敌对目标，并回收这批货物。你需要驾驶一艘能装载 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸集装箱</EM4>的飞船，并配备一把 <EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，以便将物资转运上船。

随后将货物送至 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯处。我保证，这批物资定会物尽其用。

在外务必保重，

利玛·恩迪科特
首席调度员
繁荣公民

Citizens for Prosperity is looking for any available security operatives to retake several former CFP installations near [LOCATION] from Headhunter control. These clusters were violently taken from us by [TARGET] and resulted in the deaths of many volunteers.

Lima Endicott

185t0sg.description_en:
Hello,
Need a contractor for a simple cargo haul going from a freight elevator at [LOCATION] to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION]. At most the containers will be 4 SCU in size.
Also, we strongly encourage contractors to bring a handheld tractor beam along.
Any chance you’re available to take care of it for us?
[SIGN_OFF]
Chase Hewitt
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.
185t0sg.description_zh:
哈喽，

需要一位承包商来一次简单的运货，从 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯。尺寸最大不超过 <EM4>[MAX_SCU]</EM4> 的集装箱。

顺便提醒，我们强烈建议承包商随身携带<EM4>手持式牵引光束</EM4>。

你能帮我们处理一下吗？

[SIGN_OFF]

“尽你所需，达你所在。”
